body: Hey, I'm new to this community and interested in the upcoming meeting. Could you send me an invite at yjha1@ualberta.ca?

Minutes:

- Agenda and Logistics: Attendees discussed the upcoming WHATUP meeting at W3C’s TPAC event in October and were encouraged to begin considering high-level topics for the agenda ([00:03:27](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.2yhqai6zxqr2)).
- Declarative Shadow Root Opt-ins (Issue 12652): Noam Rosenthal introduced the issue of simplifying the "allow declarative shadow root" specification, noting that the current implementation creates complexity when using document.open or detached document streaming ([00:03:27](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.2yhqai6zxqr2)). Noam Rosenthal proposed maintaining the opt-in but treating it as enabled for document.open to simplify implementation and protect against poorly configured sanitizers ([00:06:42](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.iee89k455dsv)). Olli Pettay expressed concerns regarding potential web compatibility issues caused by changing this behavior ([00:08:24](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.90rzpjuxfxyi)). The group discussed using telemetry to measure the impact and decided to collect further data before finalizing a change ([00:09:53](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.nbpnn9ci1sqi)).
- Focus Without User Activation (Issue 11839): Fernando Fiori provided an update on a permissions policy designed to block iframes from stealing focus without user gestures. Following a successful origin trial with positive feedback regarding accessibility and user experience from Microsoft Teams, Fernando Fiori proposed moving the feature to stage two ([00:13:32](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.83nsnbqsb79f)). Anne van Kesteren and other participants noted that the related pull request requires further discussion and clarification on unresolved points ([00:16:34](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.i4stwpe7pzr2)) ([00:19:56](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.tl2imbm743xb)). The group decided not to move to stage two at this time; Fernando Fiori will revisit and update the pull request, and participants will continue the review process ([00:23:54](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.nya2e6oahpxz)). It was also agreed that this issue does not need to go through the stages process, the focus should be on finishing and landing the pending PR.
- Focus Group V2 (Issue 12776): Jacques Newman introduced an addendum to the existing Focus Group proposal to support two-dimensional navigation, allowing for vertical and horizontal movement in addition to the original one-dimensional linear movement. Jacques Newman requested consensus to move to stage one, emphasizing that this is intended for table structures or generic markup rather than general spatial navigation ([00:28:58](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.f1llq4xpgmy)). Anne van Kesteren requested time to consult with colleagues before finalizing a decision, so the group agreed to postpone the discussion until the next meeting ([00:32:26](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.sf8bj61pdycd)).
- Disable Form Control Event Handling (PR 2219): Joey Arhar presented pull request 2219 to expand the specification text regarding disable form control event handling. Olli Pettay agreed that the current specification text is broken and vague, and supported the proposed improvements ([00:34:39](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.edrjqfu1bw82)). There was general agreement to move forward with the pull request, and Olli would do a review ([00:35:45](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.xze5u46bkgns)).
- Menu Elements Specification Update: Mason Freed provided a brief update regarding the Menu Elements specification, noting that David Baron is close to requesting stage three, although the draft is still being finalized ([00:35:45](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.xze5u46bkgns)).
- Original Focus Group Proposal Reminder: Jacques Newman encouraged the participants to review the original Focus Group pull request, noting that all comments have been addressed and asking them to ensure the item is not forgotten ([00:35:45](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P2czLzFvSlIW8GCroH303YysTiez_9urYVevl_inX6k/edit?userstoinvite=none&tab=t.gf1ir2hwg8zi#heading=h.xze5u46bkgns)).
